title: In Order
description: Things that only make sense in sequence — planets, cycles, layers and steps. Made for Order it.

cards.front: The planets, in order from the Sun
cards.back: Mercury → Venus → Earth → Mars → Jupiter → Saturn → Uranus → Neptune
cards.hint: My Very Easy Method Just Speeds Up Naming

cards.front: The colours of the rainbow, from the outside in
cards.back: Red → Orange → Yellow → Green → Blue → Indigo → Violet
cards.hint: Richard Of York Gave Battle In Vain

cards.note: Proving is the wait while the yeast fills the dough with gas — skip it and the loaf is a brick.

cards.front: The water cycle, starting at the sea
cards.note: Water rises as vapour, gathers into clouds, falls as rain or snow, and runs back to the sea.

cards.back: Second → Minute → Hour → Day → Week → Month → Year

cards.front: The phases of the Moon, from new to full
cards.back: New moon → Waxing crescent → First quarter → Waxing gibbous → Full moon
cards.note: Waxing means growing. After full it wanes back the same way in reverse.

cards.front: The layers of the Earth, from the outside in
cards.back: Crust → Mantle → Outer core → Inner core
cards.note: The outer core is liquid metal; the inner core is hotter still but squeezed solid.

cards.front: The layers of the atmosphere, from the ground up
cards.note: Weather happens in the first, the ozone layer sits in the second, meteors burn up in the third.

cards.front: The path food takes through the body
cards.back: Mouth → Oesophagus → Stomach → Small intestine → Large intestine
Asia → Africa → North America → South America → Antarctica → Europe → Oceania

cards.front: The order of operations in arithmetic
cards.back: Brackets → Powers → Multiply and divide → Add and subtract
cards.note: Multiplying and dividing rank equally, as do adding and subtracting — within a rank, work left to right.

cards.back: Stone Age → Bronze Age → Iron Age
cards.note: Named for what the best tools were made of.

cards.front: The ranks of living things, from kingdom down
cards.back: Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species
cards.hint: King Philip Came Over For Good Soup

cards.note: Chromosomes condense, line up in the middle, are pulled apart, and two nuclei form.

cards.front: The electromagnetic spectrum, longest wavelength first
cards.back: Radio → Microwave → Infrared → Visible → Ultraviolet → X-ray → Gamma ray
cards.note: Shorter wavelength means higher energy, which is why the far end is the dangerous one.
